title: Fragment six: for whoever found this
subtitle: A holo recording, three hundred years old
author: dubbed to tape by Lt. Shepard

lines.text: DUBBED FROM HOLO -- FRAGMENT SIX OF SIX
This one's for you. He didn't know your name either.
A bed. He is very old. The light is bad.
Six. This one is for whoever found it.
She is gone. Years now. I am going soon. It is fine.
I have left these in more than one place. I know how
things get lost. I have lost the only thing that mattered.
If you are hearing this, the world outlived us both.
I hoped it would. I did not make it to last for ever.
I made it to be left alone. Has it been left alone?
He waits, as if for an answer. The pause is long.
Probably not. Nothing is. Somebody always comes.
I did. That is how all of this started.
Whoever you are: the people on this ground are real.
Whatever anybody tells you. Whatever they are for.
I only made the ground. Everything on it made itself.
Look after it, if you can. I stopped being able to.
That was the price. I would pay it again. Every time.
There. That is all of me. You can turn it off.
He does not turn it off. The recording runs on, quiet.
-- FRAGMENT SIX ENDS --
